notes: Directional RNA-seq of fragmented rRNA-depleted RNA (small-RNA kit adapters, no size selection) -> total_rnaseq. Shift samples come from LB OD 1.0 cells ('Middle log phase'); phase kept (inferred) for samples up to 2 h after resuspension, later ones empty. Temperature, vessel and aeration of MOPS / M-C / M-P resuspensions not stated (HS: 48 C, 250 rpm). MOPS and LB samples are untreated WT references -> controls. WT re-read: MG1655 used unmodified.
